package.description: Citation analysis software program helping academics to present their case for research impact to its best advantage.

en-US.author: Tarma Software Research Ltd
en-US.description: Citation analysis software program helping academics to present their case for research impact to its best advantage.
en-US.longDescription: Publish or Perish is a software program that retrieves and analyzes academic citations. It uses various publicly available data sources to obtain the raw citations, then analyzes these and calculates a series of citation metrics. The results are available on-screen and can also be copied to the Windows clipboard (for pasting into other applications) or saved to a text file (for future reference or further analysis).
en-US.name: Harzing's Publish or Perish
en-US.releaseNotes: Adapted to new-style Google Scholar CAPTCHAs

zh-CN.author: Tarma Software Research Ltd
zh-CN.description: 帮助学者充分展示其研究影响案例的引文分析软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: Publish or Perish 是一款检索和分析学术引文的软件，通过各种公开的数据源获取原始引文，然后对其进行分析并计算一系列引文指标。结果既可以显示在屏幕上，也可以复制到 Windows 剪贴板（用于粘贴至其它应用程序）或保存到文本文件中（供将来参考或进一步分析）。
zh-CN.name: Harzing's Publish or Perish
